Reserved for later milestones; no runnable workflow is implemented here yet.


`challenge_analysis.json` contains eight synthetic Challenge Mode inputs and reviewed
advisory outputs. Its evidence specifications build deterministic knowledge states before
provider interpretation. The price alternative challenges a causal explanation, not
problem existence. All UUIDs, sources and statements are synthetic and public-safe.

`specification_drafting.json` contains ten synthetic Milestone 5 A–J drafting contracts.
Hypothesis/evidence/selection IDs are assembled offline; each case supplies expected typed
wording and origin or rejection behavior. The fixtures do not represent live model output
or certify semantic quality. No proprietary data or credentials are included.
